comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As I understand it, this skill has two purposes:

1. Allows you a free vigor recharge with barmaids/barmen (their unique dialogues are recorded under Event History->Waitresses from the front page if you're curious to read them all).

I would say this is largely useless since a course meal has the same effect and is easy to trigger if you know the mechanics (cheap non-alcoholic drink, x3 of the same food item, non-alcho drink to finish works in most ports; you won't usually get course meal bonuses that way but you will max vigor) and if you have Quarters which allow you to do the course meal trick for free in your own nation capital.

2. As Maria from 12-08-2013 in these comments stated, your character name will be mentioned more often to other players. If you like bragging rights, maybe it's useful to you?

No other benefits seem to exist beyond those. Now in order to trigger the skill, you must donate quality item gifts (equipment only, no consumables) on a regular basis, and each barmaid or barman has skills that they 'respect' (bonus points?). Sharing a drink with them may reveal this in passing, or you can check this JP wiki section with a breakdown of skills by barmaid/barman:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Bar

The title Flower Connoisseur obtained by receiving a gift from each of the major capital city barmaids (registered in Memorial Album) seems to make it easier to improve relations using this skill and is easy to unlock (drink, 3 admiral coats from Pisa item shop, drink again, pocket MA gift toward title and move on).

Although to be frank, very little research has ever been done in this field, so I am only speaking from personal experience (which is limited) and JP wikis (translated somewhat haphazardly at times). If anybody else wishes to contribute some insights to this category, feel free. Thanks. Cheers and great online voyaging to you.
